external_deps: Claude Code or another coding agent

review.tagline: Claude Code skill that generates HTML slide decks or converts PowerPoint files
review.summary: A skill for Claude Code, packaged as a plugin, that builds single-file HTML presentations with inline CSS and JS. It shows three visual style previews to pick from, then writes the full deck, or extracts text, images and notes from a .pptx and rebuilds it for the web. Other coding agents can follow the same SKILL.md if they have filesystem and shell access.
review.audience: Claude Code users who need web slide decks without writing CSS or JS
strengths: Output is one HTML file with inline CSS/JS, no npm or build step
Converts .pptx files, extracting text, images and speaker notes
Ships 12 included styles plus 34 optional bold templates loaded on demand
Installs as a Claude Code plugin or by copying files into ~/.claude/skills
weaknesses: Plugin install flow and slash command are specific to Claude Code
Other agents must read SKILL.md manually; no install path is documented for them
Output is fixed 16:9 HTML, not editable .pptx
Style previews depend on the agent's generation, so results vary per run
needs: Needs Claude Code or another coding agent, Python (scripts/extract-pptx.py)
Models: Claude Code, Codex, Kimi Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI
